deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring EnOcean devices under `{platform}` in YAML is being removed.

Your existing devices have been imported into the EnOcean integration automatically.

Remove the entries with `platform: enocean` under `{platform}` from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue. Keep the EnOcean entries under other platforms; they are not imported yet.
deprecated_yaml.title: The EnOcean {platform} YAML configuration is being removed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_already_con.description:
The device {name} configured under `{platform}` in your `configuration.yaml` file has the ID {id}. A device with this ID is already set up in the EnOcean integration with other settings, and a device can only be set up once, so this entry could not be imported.

Remove the entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_already_con.title: [%key:component::enocean::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_id::title%]

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_id.description:
The device {name} configured under `{platform}` in your `configuration.yaml` file has an ID that is not an EnOcean device ID, so it could not be imported into the EnOcean integration.

Remove the entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_id.title: An EnOcean device could not be imported from YAML

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_no_gateway.description:
The EnOcean devices configured under `{platform}` in your `configuration.yaml` file could not be imported because the EnOcean integration is not set up.

Set up the EnOcean integration and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_no_gateway.title: EnOcean devices could not be imported from YAML
